title: Network dynamics of HFOs (Lin & Stacey; Michigan): filtered and RMS iEEG snippets around interictal HFOs, 2 patients (derivative)
description: A derivative BIDS-iEEG repackaging of the Pennsieve 'Network dynamics of HFOs' release from the Stacey Lab at the University of Michigan. It contains filtered (80-500 Hz) and RMS-envelope intracranial EEG snippets around interictal high frequency oscillations (HFOs), plus background snippets, from two epilepsy surgery patients with good and poor outcomes. Per-snippet HFO metadata, electrode coordinates, seizure onset zone and resection masks, and clinical participant information are included to support HFO network analysis in epilepsy surgery outcome prediction.
methods_description: HFOs were detected on intracranial electrodes from long-term recordings (4096 Hz) using the authors' HFO-Network pipeline. Up to 500 snippets of 1441 samples at 3600 Hz around HFOs per electrode were extracted, showing all channels, with 80-500 Hz filtered signal and RMS envelope channels. 500 background (non-HFO) snippets per patient were also included. Data were repackaged to BrainVision float32 with per-snippet events, and electrode coordinates were written to electrodes.tsv without recomputing values.
